purpose: Responsive single-page layout with hero, value proposition, differentiators, testimonials, about and footer sections, rendered entirely from site.config.json and website-copy.json.

outputSchema.description: Static build artefacts for the landing page route.

configurationFields.description: Logo; a text wordmark is used when absent
Headline, subheadline and primary CTA from website-copy.json

testCases.description: Render with the apex-coaching sample config at 360px, 768px and 1280px widths
testCases.expectedOutcome: No horizontal scroll; hero CTA visible above the fold on all widths

testCases.description: Run axe accessibility scan on the rendered page
testCases.expectedOutcome: Zero serious or critical violations; colour contrast passes WCAG AA

testCases.description: Render with an empty testimonials array
testCases.expectedOutcome: Testimonials section is omitted, not shown empty

knownLimitations: Contract only: Angular implementation not yet built (Phase B).
rollbackApproach: Redeploy the previous static build artefact (kept per release tag) to the hosting provider.
